rules.name: simple_all_cards
rules.description: All cards are accepted; the rule imposes no restriction.
rules.code:
# Simple rule – always true.
if not mainline:
    return True
return True

rules.name: simple_even_ranks
rules.description: Only cards with an even rank (2,4,6,8,10,12) may be played.

rules.name: simple_odd_ranks
rules.description: Only cards with an odd rank (1,3,5,7,9,11,13) may be played.

rules.name: simple_red_only
rules.description: Only red cards (hearts or diamonds) are allowed.

rules.name: simple_black_only
rules.description: Only black cards (clubs or spades) are allowed.

rules.name: simple_hearts_only
rules.description: Only hearts may be played.

rules.name: simple_spades_only
rules.description: Only spades may be played.

rules.name: simple_face_cards
rules.description: Only face cards (Jack, Queen, King) are accepted.

rules.name: simple_number_cards
rules.description: Only number cards (Ace through 10) are accepted.

rules.name: simple_low_ranks
rules.description: Only ranks 1‑5 may be played.

rules.name: simple_high_ranks
rules.description: Only ranks 9‑13 may be played.

rules.name: simple_same_color_as_first
rules.description: The first accepted card sets a color; all later cards must match that color.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
first_color = mainline[0].color
return card.color == first_color

rules.name: simple_same_suit_as_first
rules.description: The first accepted card sets a suit; all later cards must be of that suit.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
first_suit = mainline[0].suit.suit_name
return card.suit.suit_name == first_suit

rules.name: simple_non_ace
rules.description: No Aces (rank 1) may be played.

rules.name: simple_no_king
rules.description: No Kings (rank 13) may be played.

rules.name: simple_even_or_red
rules.description: Cards are accepted if they are either even‑ranked or red.

rules.name: simple_odd_and_black
rules.description: Only cards that are both odd‑ranked and black are allowed.

rules.name: simple_rank_mod3_eq0
rules.description: Only cards whose rank is a multiple of 3 (3, 6, 9, 12) may be played.

rules.name: simple_rank_mod4_eq1
rules.description: Only cards whose rank leaves remainder 1 when divided by 4 (1, 5, 9, 13) are accepted.

rules.name: simple_alternating_colors
rules.description: Cards must alternate between red and black colors.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last = mainline[-1]
return card.color != last.color

rules.name: simple_alternating_suits
rules.description: Cards must alternate between hearts/diamonds and clubs/spades (red ↔ black).
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last = mainline[-1]
return card.color != last.color

rules.name: simple_rank_up_by_one
rules.description: Each card must have a rank exactly one higher than the previous card; Kings may be followed by any card.

rules.name: simple_rank_down_by_one
rules.description: Each card must have a rank exactly one lower than the previous card; Aces may be followed by any card.

rules.name: simple_rank_higher
rules.description: Each card must have a higher rank than the previous card; equal ranks are not allowed.

rules.name: simple_rank_lower
rules.description: Each card must have a lower rank than the previous card; equal ranks are not allowed.

rules.name: simple_parity_alternate
rules.description: Parity (odd/even) must alternate with each successive card.

rules.name: simple_same_color_as_last
rules.description: Each card must share the same color as the immediately preceding card.

rules.name: simple_same_suit_as_last
rules.description: Each card must share the same suit as the immediately preceding card.

rules.name: simple_rank_diff_at_most_two
rules.description: The absolute difference between a card’s rank and the previous card’s rank must be ≤ 2.

rules.name: simple_rank_diff_at_least_three
rules.description: The absolute difference between a card’s rank and the previous card’s rank must be ≥ 3.

rules.name: simple_red_then_low
rules.description: If the previous card is red, the next card must have rank ≤ 7; otherwise any card is allowed.

rules.name: simple_black_then_high
rules.description: If the previous card is black, the next card must have rank ≥ 7; otherwise any card is allowed.

rules.name: simple_suit_cycle_hearts
rules.description: After a hearts card, the next card must be a diamond; after a diamond, the next must be a club; after a club, the next must be a spade; after a spade, the next must be a hearts.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
order = ["hearts", "diamonds", "clubs", "spades"]
last_suit = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
next_index = (order.index(last_suit) + 1) % 4
return card.suit.suit_name == order[next_index]

rules.name: simple_rank_mod5_even
rules.description: Only cards whose rank modulo 5 is an even number (0, 2, 4) may be played.

rules.name: simple_suit_must_match_parity
rules.description: Red suits (hearts, diamonds) may only be played on even ranks; black suits (clubs, spades) only on odd ranks.

rules.name: simple_rank_sum_even
rules.description: The sum of the candidate card’s rank and the previous card’s rank must be even.

rules.name: simple_rank_product_multiple_of_three
rules.description: The product of the candidate rank and the previous rank must be divisible by 3.

rules.name: simple_color_mirror
rules.description: Every red card must be followed by a black card of the same rank, and every black card must be followed by a red card of the same rank.

rules.name: simple_suit_mirror
rules.description: Each card must be of the same rank as the previous card but of a different suit.

rules.name: simple_rank_plus_color_value
rules.description: Assign red = 0, black = 1; the candidate’s rank plus its color value must be greater than the previous card’s rank plus its color value.

rules.name: simple_even_then_odd
rules.description: Even‑ranked cards must be followed by an odd‑ranked card; odd‑ranked cards must be followed by an even‑ranked card.

rules.name: simple_red_low_black_high
rules.description: Red cards must have rank ≤ 7; black cards must have rank ≥ 7. No other restriction.

rules.name: simple_suit_color_parity
rules.description: Hearts and clubs must be even‑ranked; diamonds and spades must be odd‑ranked.

rules.name: simple_rank_fibonacci
rules.description: Each card’s rank must be a Fibonacci number (1,2,3,5,8,13). All other cards are rejected.

rules.name: simple_alternating_red_black_lowhigh
rules.description: Cards must alternate colors, and red cards must be ≤ 7 while black cards must be ≥ 7.

rules.name: simple_rank_mod7_not_one
rules.description: Cards whose rank modulo 7 equals 1 (i.e., ranks 1 and 8) are forbidden.

rules.name: simple_suit_sequence_hearts_first
rules.description: The first accepted card may be any suit; thereafter the suits must follow the fixed order hearts → diamonds → clubs → spades → hearts …
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
order = ["hearts", "diamonds", "clubs", "spades"]
if len(mainline) == 1:
    # after first card, enforce order
    return True
last_suit = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
expected = order[(order.index(last_suit) + 1) % 4]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules.name: simple_rank_sum_multiple_of_five
rules.description: The sum of the candidate rank and the previous rank must be a multiple of 5.

rules.name: simple_black_then_red_then_black
rules.description: Cards must follow the repeating pattern: black, red, black, red … (starting with any color).
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
if len(mainline) == 1:
    # second card must be opposite color of first
    return card.color != mainline[-1].color
# After the first two, enforce the same alternating pattern
last = mainline[-1]
second_last = mainline[-2]
# Determine expected color based on pattern
expected_color = second_last.color
return card.color == expected_color

rules.name: simple_rank_greater_than_average
rules.description: The candidate card’s rank must be greater than the average rank of all previously accepted cards (rounded down).
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
avg = sum(c.rank for c in mainline) // len(mainline)
return card.rank > avg

rules.name: simple_rank_less_than_median
rules.description: The candidate card’s rank must be less than the median rank of the mainline (if even number of cards, use lower median).
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
sorted_ranks = sorted(c.rank for c in mainline)
mid = (len(sorted_ranks) - 1) // 2
median = sorted_ranks[mid]
return card.rank < median

rules.name: simple_color_after_specific_rank
rules.description: If the previous card’s rank is a multiple of 4, the next card must be red; otherwise any color is allowed.

rules.name: simple_suit_after_prime
rules.description: If the previous card’s rank is a prime (2,3,5,7,11,13), the next card must be a spade; otherwise any suit is allowed.

rules.name: simple_rank_not_consecutive
rules.description: The candidate rank may not be exactly one higher or one lower than the previous rank (except when previous is Ace or King, which are unrestricted).

rules.name: simple_even_then_black
rules.description: Even‑ranked cards must be followed by a black card; odd‑ranked cards may be followed by any card.

rules.name: simple_black_then_even
rules.description: Black cards must be followed by an even‑ranked card; red cards may be followed by any card.

rules.name: simple_rank_sum_prime
rules.description: The sum of the candidate rank and the previous rank must be a prime number (2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23).

rules.name: simple_rank_product_prime
rules.description: The product of the candidate rank and the previous rank must be a prime number (only possible when one rank is 1 and the other is prime).

rules.name: simple_color_after_high_rank
rules.description: If the previous card’s rank is 9 or higher, the next card must be red; otherwise any color.

rules.name: simple_suit_after_low_rank
rules.description: If the previous card’s rank is 4 or lower, the next card must be a diamond; otherwise any suit.

rules.name: simple_rank_mod6_even
rules.description: Only cards whose rank modulo 6 is an even number (0, 2, 4) may be played.

rules.name: simple_color_then_rank_parity
rules.description: If the previous card is red, the next card must be odd; if black, the next card must be even.

rules.name: simple_suit_then_color
rules.description: If the previous card is a heart or diamond, the next card must be black; otherwise it must be red.

rules.name: simple_rank_greater_than_last_two_average
rules.description: The candidate rank must be greater than the average of the last two accepted ranks (rounded down). If fewer than two cards exist, any card is allowed.
rules.code:
if len(mainline) < 2:
    return True
avg = (mainline[-1].rank + mainline[-2].rank) // 2
return card.rank > avg

rules.name: simple_alternating_red_black_and_lowhigh
rules.description: Cards must alternate colors; red cards must be ≤ 5, black cards must be ≥ 9.

rules.name: simple_rank_not_multiple_of_three
rules.description: No card whose rank is a multiple of 3 (3, 6, 9, 12) may be played.

rules.name: simple_suit_must_be_different_from_two_back
rules.description: Each card’s suit must differ from the suit of the card two positions earlier in the mainline (if such a card exists).

rules.name: simple_rank_greater_than_all_previous
rules.description: The candidate rank must be greater than every rank that has appeared earlier in the mainline.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
max_rank = max(c.rank for c in mainline)
return card.rank > max_rank

rules.name: simple_rank_lower_than_all_previous
rules.description: The candidate rank must be lower than every rank that has appeared earlier in the mainline.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
min_rank = min(c.rank for c in mainline)
return card.rank < min_rank

rules.name: simple_color_repeat_after_two
rules.description: A card’s color must be the same as the card two positions earlier (if that card exists).

rules.name: simple_suit_repeat_every_three
rules.description: Every third card must repeat the suit of the card three steps earlier; other positions have no restriction.

rules.name: simple_rank_sum_mod4_zero
rules.description: The sum of the candidate rank and the previous rank must be divisible by 4.

rules.name: simple_rank_product_mod5_one
rules.description: The product of the candidate rank and the previous rank, modulo 5, must equal 1.

rules.name: simple_alternating_lowhigh
rules.description: Cards must alternate between “low” (rank ≤ 7) and “high” (rank ≥ 8) categories.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last_low = mainline[-1].rank <= 7
curr_low = card.rank <= 7
return last_low != curr_low

rules.name: simple_suit_parity_match
rules.description: Hearts and clubs are considered “even” suits; diamonds and spades “odd”. The parity of the suit must match the parity of the rank.

rules.name: simple_color_then_suit_cycle
rules.description: If the previous card is red, the next must be a club; if black, the next must be a diamond.

rules.name: simple_rank_plus_color_mod3
rules.description: Assign red = 0, black = 1; (rank + color value) modulo 3 must equal 2.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
color_val = 0 if card.color == "red" else 1
return (card.rank + color_val) % 3 == 2

rules.name: simple_rank_diff_multiple_of_four
rules.description: The absolute difference between the candidate rank and the previous rank must be a multiple of 4.

rules.name: simple_suit_after_even_rank
rules.description: If the previous card’s rank is even, the next card must be a spade; otherwise any suit.

rules.name: simple_color_after_queen
rules.description: If the previous card is a Queen (rank 12), the next card must be black; otherwise any color.

rules.name: simple_rank_not_prime
rules.description: No prime‑ranked cards (2,3,5,7,11,13) may be played.

rules.name: simple_rank_is_square
rules.description: Only cards whose rank is a perfect square (1, 4, 9) are accepted.
